title: Precision & Stability Update
headline: Smarter diagnostics, a cleaner installer, and a faster AI workflow — plus several reliability fixes.
changes: Fixed: Input Latency monitor was always showing 1.4ms regardless of system load — now uses continuous power-curve scaling against real CPU, RAM, and process data so values reflect actual system state.
Fixed: Admin stats panel failed to load on fresh installs due to a missing database table — resolved with automatic table creation on startup.
Fixed: Installer package included website-only assets (SEO files, blueprint images) — these are now excluded, reducing package overhead.
New: AI Advisor now surfaces inline tweak recommendation cards with a direct apply flow — act on suggestions without leaving the chat.
